stages.name: Apertura play-offs
stages.note: Top four: two-legged semi-finals and a two-legged final.

stages.name: Apertura grand final
stages.note: Only if the regular-phase winner and the play-off winner differ.

stages.name: Clausura
stages.note: Identical second tournament, January-May, independent title.

playoff.note: Four-team knockout (semi-finals and final over two legs). If the play-off winner is not the regular-phase winner, a two-legged grand final decides the tournament.

conflicts.topic: Single row, but two tournaments and a grand final
conflicts.detail: CRPD is stored as one league. In reality the season is Apertura + Clausura, each 18 rounds plus a four-team knockout and a possible grand final, with two titles. Treating the row as one 36-round table (the older 12-club description) gives the wrong fixtures.

conflicts.topic: The league page still says 22 matchdays
conflicts.detail: The Liga FPD format prose describes a double round-robin of 22 matchdays, which was the 12-club shape. Since 2025-26 the league has ten clubs and an 18-match regular phase; the 2025-26 season article is the correct source.

conflicts.topic: Ten clubs is recent and partly administrative
conflicts.detail: The league dropped from 12 to 10 for 2025-26 after Guanacasteca and Santos de Guapiles had their licences revoked. A sim seeded with older data will show 12.

conflicts.topic: Closed downwards by our data, not by reality
conflicts.detail: One club is relegated each season on the aggregate Apertura+Clausura table, to the Liga de Ascenso. That league is not in our list, so the report marks the direction closed (per the task rule for single-row countries).

notes: Season 2026-27 (Apertura July-December 2026, Clausura January-May 2027). Size 10 and level match our row. Relegation: one club, bottom of the combined Apertura+Clausura table. No promotion in our data. Cups and CONCACAF competitions excluded.
